name: Canva
description: design creation and editing, asset and brand management, search, export, commenting, and etc.
authorization.title: Authorize a Canva China account
authorization.description: After an administrator configures the OAuth client, each user signs in and grants access on Canva's official page. Available designs, assets, and brand resources depend on that user's permissions and plan.
configuration.endpoint.label: MCP endpoint
configuration.endpoint.description: The China endpoint used by the source connector. Keep the default value.
configuration.clientId.label: OAuth Client ID
configuration.clientId.description: A client ID registered with Canva China's MCP service. Register the POCO callback URL; see skills/canva/references/setup.md in this package for instructions.
configuration.clientSecret.label: OAuth Client Secret
configuration.clientSecret.description: The secret for the same client, registered with client_secret_basic authentication. POCO stores it encrypted.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.designs.title: Design generation and editing
capabilities.designs.description: Find and read existing designs, generate candidates, create designs, and modify content through editing transactions.
capabilities.assets.title: Assets and brand resources
capabilities.assets.description: Upload assets from URLs, manage folders, read brand kits and templates, and populate templates with content.
capabilities.export.title: Import, resize, and export
capabilities.export.description: Import files from URLs, copy or resize designs, and export in formats supported by the service.
capabilities.comments.title: Comment collaboration
capabilities.comments.description: Read design comments and replies, and add comments and feedback.
limits.title: Availability and time limits
limits.description: Tools must be returned by the China service and allowed by this package. Generation, editing, uploads, exports, and comments require confirmation. Canva recommends allowing 60 seconds for design generation, while POCO currently limits remote calls to 30 seconds, so longer operations may time out. Do not resubmit when the result is uncertain.
